content:
sec-bot: Security scanner detected a HIGH severity finding: CVE-2024-9999 in 'libfast' (transitive) present in builder image rw-builder:2026-03-19. SBOM entry updated. tagging @anna @devin
anna: On it — thanks. where in CI was this detected? build job id?
sec-bot: CI: /ci/builds/7890, detected at SBOM-scan stage. Evidence: dependency tree -> common-lib@2.3.0 -> fastmsg (libfast)@1.2.1 (CVE-2024-9999). Severity: critical (RCE).
devin: We should quarantine the image and halt deploys from that builder. @sre-ops can you add an image-deny rule? also need to check if KMS signing key used to sign artifacts was misused.
sre-ops: Quarantine action: moving rw-builder:2026-03-19 -> quarantine/1908765432 now. Blocking release pipelines referencing that builder (set SKIP_DEPLOY=1). Will attach ACL/audit logs here.
mohammad: How did this slip through? our SBOM gate should have flagged on publish. is this a new transitive introduced by common-lib bump?
jess: I pulled the SBOM diff — common-lib@2.3.0 added fastmsg transitively via common-parser. PR: https://github.com/redwood/common-lib/pull/248
devin: OK open hotfix: revert or pin the transitive bump in common-lib. @jess can you create a PR to pin fastmsg to 1.2.0 and trigger a rebuild?
jess: Creating PR now: "hotfix: pin fastmsg to 1.2.0". running full pipeline with SCA. ETA ~15m.
anna: Audit question: who can quarantine images and rotate KMS signing keys? need an audit entry for this incident.
mohammad: RBAC note: only sec-admins + infra-oncall can rotate primary artifact KMS keys. Quarantine is performed by registry-service account; need to record which human approved it. @sre-ops please attach audit log export.
sre-ops: Log snippet attached: action=quarantine image=rw-builder:2026-03-19 by=registry-service@redwood principal=svc-registry service_account. Human approval recorded by=anna. Ticket created INC-1921. pushing full logs to s3://secure-logs/incidents/INC-1921/
anna: Thanks. KMS question: do we suspect key compromise? any abnormal sign/rotate events?
devin: Quick KMS check: no unexpected rotates or key creations. there are multiple Sign operations from the build pipeline at the time — expected. Still recommend rotating the ephemeral signing key used by the pipeline and re-signing new images.
mohammad: Agree rotate ephemeral signing key now. long-term: tighten RBAC for sign operations and require 2 human approvals for rotating primary artifact signing keys.
anna: Can we also run dynamic sandboxes on the quarantined image to confirm exploitability before final disposition?
sre-ops: Spawning sandbox run (cwe-runner) with exploit checks. will post results in ~30m.
oncall-bot: Reminder: incident SLA P0 acknowledged. next update in 30m or sooner. :alarm_clock:
jess: PR merged and pinned dependency. new builder image pushed: rw-builder:2026-03-19-hotfix. triggering SBOM & SCA scans now.
sec-bot: New SBOM scan: libfast@1.2.1 not present in rw-builder:2026-03-19-hotfix. sandbox dynamic run shows no exploit observed. recommended actions: rotate ephemeral signing key, attach audit logs to INC-1921, then lift deployment block.
anna: Agreed. @sre-ops rotate keys, attach audit export, and remove deployment block. postmortem to follow with timeline + remediations (stricter SBOM gate + RBAC changes).
sre-ops: Keys rotated: artifact-signer-ephemeral rotated_by=infra-oncall@redwood rotation_ts=1908765798. rotation logged and uploaded. release block removed.
anna: filing post-incident action items: 1) stricter SBOM gating on publish 2) RBAC tighten for KMS sign/rotate 3) SBOM-diff alerts on dependency bumps. will create AD-456 and link to INC-1921. closing once postmortem draft is shared.
sec-bot: INC-1921 updated with logs, sandbox output, and actions. notifying stakeholders, marking follow-up tasks. :white_check_mark:
